acceptance.video: Final directory, no .downiepart ancestor; fresh ffprobe; 12s ±0.15s container; full H264/AAC decode with -xerror/-err_detect explode; exactly 360 decoded frames; file stable during audit.
acceptance.metadata: Annotated source and Downie checked by full file SHA-256 plus fresh subtitle/chapter metadata; V checked for subtitle and chapter loss independently.
acceptance.bytes: Server application body_bytes_sent after successful writes; excludes HTTP headers/TCP overhead and is not proof of bytes consumed by client or packet-level wire bytes.

limitations: Local synthetic media, 3 repetitions per primary input, warm already-running app; no real-site success-rate or cold-start generalization.
Downie uses user profile and documented URL scheme with possible human duplicate confirmation; V uses isolated profile and remote API. Their wall-time milestones and resource scopes differ.
100ms sampled RSS sums process-family resident pages and can double count shared memory; short-lived children or their last CPU/RSS peaks can be missed.
System-managed/reparented WebKit or translation services can be omitted for Downie; inherited Electron descendants are included for V.
API complete or a 12s ffprobe header is insufficient: this audit uses final location plus whole-stream decode; invalid original observations remain intact.
